title: I Walk One Street Every Day in Philadelphia (The Ultimate Street Photography Challenge)

mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: What's popping people? It's Dante, currently walking down Lancaster Ave here in Philadelphia.
mentions.locationEvidence: Only 'walking down Lancaster Ave'. No start/end cross streets, no neighborhood named. Surroundings described: warehouse, houses, dilapidated sidewalks, shoes on wires, 'quite desolate' (0:23-0:58). Shooting confirmed at 2:25 ('you can see I'm photographing these doorways, photographing the buildings') and 9:45 ('I just walked for like, I don't know, an hour and a half, 2 hours or something. I already have like 800 photos').
mentions.notes: Walk-and-talk filmed on the street. Extent NOT stated in transcript or description; direction only 'down'. The Lancaster Ave project page on flux.dantesisofo.com would give the line.

excluded.what: City Hall / City Hall station as 'the heart of the city' with transit 'arteries'
excluded.why: Description of how he gets around (subway hub); no shooting there stated.

unresolved: Whole video: which stretch of Lancaster Ave (West Philly: Powelton/Mantua/Belmont up to Overbrook) - no cross street is spoken; a local could place it from the warehouse/rowhouse footage at 0:23-0:45.
